name: Interactive Isocontouring of High-Order Surfaces (iHOS)
definition: A GPU-based method for interactive rendering of isosurfaces defined by high-order multivariate polynomials, using seed projection and ray casting with early-z culling.
summary: iHOS is a GPU-based hybrid method for interactive visualization of high-order isosurfaces, using object-space seed projection and image-space ray casting to achieve high frame rates.
